name: siue-games
description: Build and test tooling for every game: TypeScript type checks and esbuild bundles into each game's checked-in dist/.

scripts.build: for f in */build.json; do [ -f $f ] || continue; node _kit/build/build.mjs ${f%/*} || exit 1; done
scripts.check: for f in */build.json; do [ -f $f ] || continue; node _kit/build/build.mjs ${f%/*} --check || exit 1; done; for f in */tools/icon.svg; do [ -f $f ] || continue; node _kit/build/icons.mjs ${f%%/*} --check || exit 1; done
